entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from the network to the UE.

entities.name: Message containing PCO
entities.description: A NAS message that includes the Protocol configuration options IE when the network wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where either the UE does not support extended protocol configuration options or the network does not support it end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The message includes the Protocol configuration options IE when the network wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE.
The inclusion of Protocol configuration options IE is guarded by the condition that extended protocol configuration options is not supported.
